title: Fractal Neural Synthesis: Constant-Storage Procedural Weight Derivation via Complex Quadratic Boundary Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.32393v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conventional neural networks store synaptic parameters as explicit tensors whose persistent Flash footprint scales linearly (O(W)) with parameter count, constraining resource-limited edge microcontrollers. We formulate and systematically evaluate Fractal Neural Synthesis (FNS), a procedural weight derivation architecture that replaces hidden-layer matrices with a constant 24-byte coordinate seed Theta = (c_x, c_y, ell) in F_64^3 anchored near the complex quadratic bifurcation boundary dM of f_c(z) = z^2 + c. We introduce a large-bailout (R = 256) smooth escape kernel, four zero-overhead geometric sampling apertures--Cartesian Grid, coprime 3x3 Rule-of-Thirds (Z/9Z), phi-Vogel spiral, and multi-scale Harmonic Tripod--and prove conditional Kolmogorov (K_Kolm <= 192 + c_0 bits) and Shannon entropy bounds. Across magnifications zeta in [10^0, 10^8], C^1 Fourier and lattice-noise bases collapse to post-standardization rank ~2.25 and SHA-256 P

translated_title: 分形神经合成：基于复二次边界动力学的恒定存储过程式权重推导
translated_abstract: 传统神经网络将突触参数存储为显式张量，其持久化Flash占用随参数数量呈线性增长（O(W)），这限制了资源受限的边缘微控制器的应用。我们提出并系统评估了分形神经合成（FNS），这是一种过程式权重推导架构，用一个属于F_64^3、锚定在f_c(z) = z^2 + c的复二次分岔边界dM附近的恒定24字节坐标种子Theta = (c_x, c_y, ell)来替代隐藏层矩阵。我们引入了大逃逸半径（R = 256）平滑逃逸核，以及四种零开销几何采样孔径——笛卡尔网格、互素3x3三分法网格（Z/9Z）、phi-Vogel螺旋和多尺度调和三脚架——并证明了条件Kolmogorov复杂度界（K_Kolm ≤ 192 + c_0比特）和香农熵界。在放大倍数ζ ∈ [10^0, 10^8]范围内，C^1傅里叶基和格点噪声基在标准化后坍缩至秩约2.25，SHA-256 P……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出分形神经合成（FNS）架构，用仅24字节、锚定于复二次分岔边界的分形坐标种子，通过过程式推导生成神经网络权重并证明了熵界，将存储占用从随参数量线性增长降低到常数级，适用于资源受限的边缘微控制器。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Fractal Neural Synthesis (FNS), which procedurally derives neural network weights from a constant 24-byte fractal coordinate seed anchored near the complex quadratic bifurcation boundary, proving entropy bounds while reducing storage from linear in parameter count to constant size for resource-constrained edge devices.
